name: Ichimatsu Akito
source:
A freshman belonging to the Faculty of Letters at R University. He has the ability of "eavesdropping," which enables him to listen in on other people's auditory information. Perhaps because of this, he has a cold disposition, but his curiosity is strong.

He is independently pursuing a murder case that occurred a month ago. 
His hobbies are playing chess and reading mystery novels.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_akito.html]official website[/url]]
